methods.label: Make the inner function equal the desired input
methods.explanation:
To find \(f(\tfrac12)\), choose an input \(x\) for which \(g(x)=\tfrac12\). Since \(g(x)=1-x^2\), we want \(x^2=\tfrac12\). One permissible choice is \(x=1/\sqrt2\), which is nonzero.

Substituting this input into the given identity yields
\[
f\left(\frac12\right)
=\frac{1-\frac12}{\frac12}=1.
\]
Thus the answer is \(1\), choice B.
